children: Users of artificial-intelligence models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Grok were experiencing outages at the same time on Thursday.
Users were reporting issues starting around 9:15 a.m. EDT, according to Downdetector, a website that tracks internet outages.
The cause of the outages wasn't immediately clear.
The three companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
OpenAI said on its status website that it was experiencing elevated errors across both ChatGPT and Codex, while Anthropic said on its status website that its Opus 4.8 and Opus 5 models were affected.
